about: AheadSteps (#397): finds the step that has to be started ahead of time, so the evening-before reminder can quote it. Matched in the recipe's own language only. All fragments are regexes, matched case-insensitively and, in a spaced language, as whole words (never inside a longer word); groups are non-capturing. always: a phrase that says so by itself ('overnight', 'the day before', 'make ahead'). verbs: an action that is ahead of time only when the same sentence also gives at least two hours ('marinate for 8 hours', 'chill at least 2 hours'): the hours come right after the verb or just before it. hours: the unit words for hours. counts: words that stand for two hours or more before an hours word ('two', 'several', 'a few'); a digit counts when it is 2 or more, and in a range its first number decides ('8 to 12 hours'; '1 to 2 hours' is not enough). upTo: words right before an amount that make it a limit, not a wait ('up to 2 hours'). skip: phrases that must never trigger; a match that overlaps one is dropped ('soak up the sauce', 'rest for 5 minutes', 'no need to marinate'). A language with no table detects nothing.
skip: なくても(?:よい|構いません).*
